name: history-bounded-blob-batches
goal: Bound Git blob batch memory while preserving committed reads.

evidence: A large history source index gathers thousands of Git blobs into an unbounded response and overlapping reads can launch another response concurrently.

The existing populated read case covers large single blobs, missing objects and retry, but not many simultaneous blobs or overlapping batches. Extend that same case with real Git fixtures and bounded response checks.
Committed case 264233787b observed two simultaneous Git payload batches; record eb92dc67dbd4.
Commit 4528125944 serializes Git payload batches and bounds their count and declared bytes.
